name: Iskenderun Demir ve Çelik A.S.
summary: Iskenderun Demir ve Çelik A.S. produces and sells flat steel products in Turkey. The company offers hot-rolled flat steel products, including rolled or steel sheets, plate steels, deep drawable steels, wheel and chassis steels, general structural steels, hot rolled pipe steels, pressure vessels and hot rolled steels for pressure purposes, hot rolled steel for welded gas cylinders, and medium and high strength shipbuilding steels. It also provides long products, such as thin wires, welding wires, tire wires, fasteners, PC strands, and springs; and billets used for coil, construction steel, profile, rail, and seamless pipe manufacturing.
